# PitchGrade

> PitchGrade is an AI-powered platform for pitch deck review, startup fundraising guidance, and comprehensive business analysis with SWOT and competitive intelligence.

PitchGrade combines an intelligent pitch deck review tool with extensive business intelligence resources covering public companies, startup fundraising strategies, and market analysis. The platform serves entrepreneurs, investors, and business professionals seeking data-driven insights for pitch optimization and competitive positioning.

## Key Topics

- Pitch Deck
- SWOT Analysis
- Business Model
- Financial Metrics
- Startup Fundraising
- Competitive Analysis
- TAM/SAM/SOM
- Investor Guide
- Company Valuation
- Market Positioning
- Competitive Positioning
- Investment Analysis
- Business Model Analysis
- Traction Metrics
- Workplace Culture

## Core Tools & Features

- [Pitch Deck Review Tool - PitchGrade](https://pitchgrade.com/review): AI-powered pitch deck review tool providing instant feedback on presentations
